title: GraphMAS: A Systematic Benchmark of Multi-Agent Coordination for Graph Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.39777v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM-based multi-agent systems coordinate specialized reasoning through aggregation, interaction, and adaptive control, yet their potential for graph learning remains unexplored. Graph learning is a natural setting for such systems because useful evidence may arise from heterogeneous local, long-range, global structural, and semantic perspectives whose relevance varies across instances. Existing LLM-based graph learning approaches primarily rely on single-agent reasoning, while multi-agent coordination has been studied mainly in general reasoning settings. Consequently, it remains unclear whether multiple specialized agents can improve graph learning and how coordination strategies should be designed and evaluated. To address this gap, we introduce GraphMAS, a systematic benchmark of multi-agent coordination for graph learning. translated_title: GraphMAS：图学习中多智能体协调的系统性基准测试
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统能够通过聚合、交互和自适应控制来协调专门化推理，但其在图学习中的潜力仍未被探索。图学习是此类系统的天然应用场景，因为有用的证据可能来自异构的局部、长程、全局结构和语义等多种视角，而这些视角的相关性会因具体实例而异。现有的基于LLM的图学习方法主要依赖单智能体推理，而多智能体协调此前主要在一般推理场景中被研究。因此，多个专门化智能体能否改进图学习，以及协调策略应当如何设计和评估，目前仍不清楚。为填补这一空白，我们提出了GraphMAS——一个针对图学习的多智能体协调系统性基准。GraphMAS构建了一个共享的图推理专家池，并沿两个维度组织协调工作。
tldr: 提出了GraphMAS——首个针对图学习中多智能体协调的系统性基准，通过构建共享的图推理专家池并沿两个维度组织协调，探索多个专门化智能体能否以及如何改进基于LLM的图学习。
en_tdlr: GraphMAS is introduced as the first systematic benchmark of multi-agent coordination for graph learning, building a shared pool of graph reasoning specialists organized along two coordination dimensions to evaluate whether and how multiple specialized agents can improve LLM-based graph learning.
